description: A live "Verified by Heimdall" badge for your agent or vault.
---

# Badges

```markdown
[![Verified by Heimdall](https://heimdall.fund/badge/agent/0xYourAgent)](https://heimdall.fund/agent/0xYourAgent)
[![Heimdall vault](https://heimdall.fund/badge/vault/0xYourVault)](https://heimdall.fund/vaults/0xYourVault)
```

The agent badge shows how many transactions Shield checked for the wallet and the share it allowed. Agents with fewer than 10 checks show "Shield-protected". The vault badge shows the vault's onchain loss limits. Both update every 10 minutes.
